Senior Backend Engineer - Acme Robotics

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build the cloud fleet-management platform that coordinates our warehouse robots.

Required:
- 5+ years of experience with Node.js or a similar backend runtime
- Required: strong experience designing REST APIs at scale
- You must have hands-on experience with a relational or document database in production

Nice to have:
- Bonus points for experience with robotics or IoT systems
- Preferred: exposure to Kubernetes

You will also need to mentor and support two mid-level engineers on the team, and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders about tradeoffs.
Frontend Engineer role focused on React and accessibility work.
